about: qm-s1-gstack-probe-2026-11: whether installing gstack's router in QM changes what Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol do on five invented requests (opens, starts, cost and prompt size in the report).

steps.note: The script reads ../turns.jsonl beside itself and writes its two files beside itself, so it runs on the scratch copy.

not_rebuilt.reason: The S1 driver (harnesses/qm/gstack/s1-probe.ts) writes it only at the end of a live run, which builds and starts QM in Docker and calls the models; it has no mode that rebuilds the summary from turns.jsonl afterwards.
